description: This file defines a class 'PostgreSqlStorageForTesting' that provides PostgreSQL-specific implementations for setting up and testing relational storage in a testing environment. It includes templates for creating and dropping databases, checking existence, and executing setup scripts.

classes.name: PostgreSqlStorageForTesting
classes.description: A test utility class for managing PostgreSQL relational storage during testing.

methods.name: PostgreSqlStorageForTesting
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the storage with a connection string or default testing configuration.

methods.name: get_CancellationTestQuery
methods.description: Returns a SQL query that sleeps to test cancellation.

methods.name: get_CreateStreamTestTable
methods.description: Returns a SQL statement to create a testing stream table.

methods.name: get_CreateDatabaseTemplate
methods.description: Returns the SQL template for creating a database.

methods.name: get_DropDatabaseTemplate
methods.description: Returns the SQL template for dropping a database, with force.

methods.name: get_ExistsDatabaseTemplate
methods.description: Returns a SQL query template for checking if a database exists.

methods.name: ConvertToExecutableBatches
methods.description: Converts setup scripts into executable batches with additional setup like creating test tables.
